source: Local machine (the same laptop as the 2026-09-30 test)
display_language: Chinese (Simplified). PowerShell and winget messages are in Chinese; zoxide messages are English.
scope: All steps as printed. The user name in paths is replaced with YourName.
method: Local Windows machine. Each step runs in a fresh pwsh -NoProfile process with the user PATH re-read, as a new window would. The init line lives in a temporary profile file that each session dot-sources. PowerShell records directories from its prompt function, so the session calls the prompt function after each Set-Location, which is what pressing Enter in a window does. User home is shown as C:\Users\YourName.

commands.label: session with the profile line (prompt drawn after each visit)
commands.command:
$env:Path = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path","Machine") + ";" + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path","User")

Visit 'C:\Users\YourName\AppData\Local\Temp\zo-evidence-20261108\zo-demo'

Visit 'C:\Users\YourName\AppData\Local\Temp\zo-evidence-20261108\zo-demo\projects\api-server'
'--- zoxide query -ls'
zoxide query -ls | Where-Object { $_ -like '*zo-demo\*\*' }
Set-Location 'C:\Users\YourName\AppData\Local\Temp\zo-evidence-20261108\zo-demo'
'--- z web'
z web 2>&1 | Out-String
'--- z web src'
z web src; (Get-Location).Path
Set-Location 'C:\Users\YourName\AppData\Local\Temp\zo-evidence-20261108\zo-demo'
'--- z proj api'
z proj api; (Get-Location).Path
'--- zi (fzf on PATH: ' + [bool](Get-Command fzf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) + ')'
